parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate 'DebugMetricsProvider.init' in that file is almost certainly a local convenience copy written to support the demo harness. Extracting the production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' into shared code on the basis of this pairing would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical restraint pattern. No refactor is warranted unless the sample-app copy is confirmed to be a leftover prototype that should simply be deleted.
